messages:
ash: heads up — started seeing a spike in client reconnects from the new eu-edge pool ~10:20 UTC. clients reconnect loop after ~30s, sometimes billed twice.
ash: sample log: ```stream.conn=closed reason=drain jitter_ms=210 route=eu-edge-3 session=X-abc123 new_conn=true quota_event=charge``` 
ash: this started after the rolling update for the routing policy (prefer-local -> prefer-capacity). anyone else? :thinking_face:
devon: saw something similar in staging earlier. suspect drain timing + keepalive mismatch between proxy and runtime. proxy closes, client resumes, runtime treats resume as fresh connect for billing.
sam: can you paste the proxy logs? curious if we see a 1001 (going away) vs 1000 close code.
ash: proxy logs (snippet): ```[10:20:12] proxy: conn_close id=X-abc123 code=1001 route=eu-edge-3 downstream_keepalive=15s upstream_grace=30s``` 
ash: runtime logs: ```[10:20:12] runtime: resume_attempt session=X-abc123 kvcache_hit=false treat_as_new=true charge_token=token-42``` 
devon: yup. upstream_grace (proxy) < upstream_resume_window (runtime) so resume still treated as new. Also the jitter makes it borderline — sometimes proxy times out a hair earlier.
sam: that explains double billing. billing shard counts a new stream creation in the meter because resume flag wasn't set.
maria: product/console question — current dashboard just shows total active streams by region. we don't have per-edge or per-route split in the rollout view, which makes debugging rollouts painful. can we add a per-route breakdown and a resume/new connect ratio?
devon: agree. short-term: increase proxy.keepalive to 45s for eu-edge or lower runtime's resume window to 20s. long-term: we need an explicit handshake header that marks resumed sessions so billing isn't ambiguous (e.g. X-Stream-Resume: true).
ash: would adding X-Stream-Resume break any client libs? we have some mobile clients that don't set cookies well.
sam: should be opt-in and server-populated when we validate the resume token. client doesn't set it; runtime can set preserve flag in session metadata and proxy forwards a header on reconnect.
devon: also noticed the console telemetry is sampling stream starts aggressively; sampling key loses the resume vs new distinction. telemetry pipeline drops resume flag at collector level because of schema mismatch.
ash: oh that's nasty. so even if runtime marks resume, the collector schema turns it into null and downstream dashboards show only new_conn=true counts.
maria: prioritizing console change — I'll open a small ticket to: 1) add per-route breakdown; 2) surface resume/new ratio in the streaming tile; 3) add a rollout UX toggle to show edge-level splits. product wants an example mock by EOD.
ops-bot: deploy initiated by devon on eu-edge pool (canary -> 20%) at 10:45 UTC :rocket:
monitor-bot: alert: streaming-error-rate increase on eu-edge-3 between 10:18 and 10:23 (5xxs and disconnects). threshold breached.
sam: putting a temporary mitigation on the canary — pausing further rollouts until we push a change to keepalives and telemetry.
devon: plan: 1) rollback prefer-capacity flag on eu-edge-3 (immediate), 2) bump proxy.keepalive to 45s (canary), 3) add resume header and update collector schema (staged). I can PR the keepalive change now.
ash: thanks. also let's add a debug console view that shows raw stream headers for a selected session id (for on-call). would make these incidents much faster to debug.
maria: noted — debug view is approved for on-call only. UX will be minimal: session id input -> raw headers + route timeline.
ash: will follow up with links to a couple of affected session ids.
ash: thanks all, keeping this thread for postmortem notes. :eyes:
